content.short: Jones DAO is a yield, strategy, and liquidity protocol for options.
content.description: Jones DAO is an options yield, strategy, and liquidity protocol that uses vaults to provide users with one-click access to institutional-grade options strategies and to fund yield-bearing, options-backed asset tokens. It is designed for people who don't want to actively manage their option positions or to lock their assets in long-lived option vaults, keeping deposits liquid and transferable. The protocol also helps treasuries and other protocols pursue higher yields on idle or treasury assets by deploying capital into diversified option strategies.
